S: the battle on the plains of Wakanda
Beef strips coated in ground peanuts, paprika, ginger and chilli, grilled on skewers, with sliced onion and tomato.
Bruce crashing through the roof of the Sanctum

Light choux pastry beaten with gruyère and mustard, piped into balls and baked until puffed, crisp outside and hollow and cheesy within. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
School bus ham and cheese pizza scrolls
Peter on the school bus over Queens

Soft scone dough spread with tomato paste, rolled with ham, cheddar and oregano, sliced and baked golden, easy to grab on the bus. Rub 60g butter into 400g self-raising flour, then mix in 250ml milk to a soft dough. Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 3 tbsp tomato paste, scatter with 150g chopped ham, 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Lay in a lined tin, cut side up, and bake at 210C for 20 minutes until golden.
M: Thanos resting on his farm at the very end
A simple vegetable stew of pumpkin, chickpeas, tomato and spinach simmered with cumin, served with flatbread.
Wakandan chicken with jollof and plantain
Wakanda, where the heroes make their stand

Chicken thighs marinated in ginger, garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals, with smoky tomato jollof rice and fried sweet plantain. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 2 tbsp grated ginger, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the juice of 2 limes and oil for 1 hour. Fry 1 onion, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp curry powder, then 300g rice and 500ml stock. Cover and cook gently 25 minutes. Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced ripe plantains in oil until caramelised.
W: Six jelly cups in six stone colours, each set around matching fruit, from raspberry red to blueberry blue, with vanilla cream on top. Make up 3 packets of jelly in red, orange and green as the packets say, then set three more colours, each 250ml liquid with 2 tsp gelatine dissolved in: apple juice for yellow, grape juice for purple and butterfly pea tea for blue. Pour each into a glass over matching fruit: raspberries, mango, green grapes, tinned pineapple, purple grapes and blueberries. Chill 4 hours. Top with 200ml cream whipped with vanilla.
K: Fresh pineapple blended with ginger and lime, strained and sweetened with honey, poured very cold over ice with mint and a pineapple wedge. Peel and chop 1 pineapple and blend with a 5cm knob of peeled ginger, the juice of 2 limes, 3 tbsp honey and 500ml cold water until smooth. Strain through a sieve, pressing on the pulp. Chill for 1 hour. Pour into 4 glasses of ice, top each with a splash of soda water and garnish with mint and a pineapple wedge.
